name: Tauric
body:
Tauric
Source Cohorts and Companions pg. 9
Starting Statistics: Size Small/Medium (see below); Speed: 40 ft.; AC: +2 natural armor; Saves: Fort (good), Ref (bad), Will (good); Attack: 2 claws (1d4); Ability Scores: Str 14, Dex 14, Con 13, Int 7, Wis 10, Cha 11; Free Evolutions: claws, limbs (arms), limbs (legs) (2)
Size: When summoned, a tauric eidolon is Small unless it spends 2 points from its evolution pool.
